items.note: The plan gives the copy/side-injection/gather/scatter maps, the eight-row subtract-add-undo schedule making the net change independent of the scratch values, the central coefficients |S cap T| mod 2 and (|S cap T|-1)/2 with side-wire cancellation, and the three-stage composition (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x), all as in 741-765. It never states h=100, N or the wire counts W_b, W_c (767-783).

It states D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} and the route operator eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}, including auxiliary roles. The proof uses the paper's invariant: the stored array is D_v applied to the logical array, and a common frame commutes with a pointwise linear gate (804-817).

The lemma is stated correctly: comparable nondegenerate labels, only central edges 3->4 decrease (each by h), L=Ich, total Wm-2N+2L, orthonormal residual bases, and ratios 100/539 and 101/539. The route also matches: terminal sums, stage transitions, central-wire loss of P(x)F, telescoping. But the per-time gate labels (eq:motif-labels, 975-988) and the edge-residual table are missing. That includes the side-wire chain P(x)<t_X> in P(x)t_Y^perp, where neighbour orthogonality is actually used (1044-1060).

Every step of the proof at 1156-1171 is reproduced: rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, the N negative source projections giving a first edge 2P_{U_a} of rank one, s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b with deficit N-2L_b>0, and the endpoint difference P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m. The headline calls the projections 'frames' where the paper's frames are the shears Phi_{P_U}, but S3.3 uses Phi_M correctly.

The steps follow the proof: weight additivity mod 4 on orthogonal vectors, odd weight giving phase +-1, H diag(1,-1) H = X giving aI+bX_v, tensoring over k columns, the X_a->Y_a exception (C^{-1} on 27 coordinates) corrected by Z_{a,k} and i^{27k}, then negation and return. The fact that the full label has frame C^{(x)m} because q_F=wt is left implicit.

The chain L/N<1/2 -> deficits N-2L_b>0 and 2N-2L_c>0 -> s<Wm -> eta>20*2^{-50} -> s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50} follows the paper. The exact deficits eta_b=339/22587335000000 and eta_c=73/19906842167500 are never given. The step log m<20 is only implicit in the inequality m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20*2^{-50}).

Both lemmas are stated with their content: the digit permutations and moves, split/merge, cyclic row split into W streams, and the controlled shift y->y+a mod q^b with b^{O(1)} offsets or unit scaling, each O(V). No proof is given.

The factorization A=E_1 Pi E_2 and the cost of exactly rank(A) interchanges plus O(V) are stated correctly. The shear derivation (triangular transforms, then D_j+=H_i, swap, D_j=H_i-D_j per one of Pi) is the paper's. The elimination proof of the factorization (1375-1392) and the choice of a fixed odd prime q avoiding the denominators (1413-1423) are missing.

The plan follows the proof step by step: cyclic row split into W role streams of volume V/W, Phi_{A_e} on edges by recursive interchanges, the endpoint identity giving H<-H+D on every row, the three updates giving the interchange, s calls, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), the geometric sum split at a<=1 and a>1, and the depth-first parking schedule.

The O(Vu^tau) bound and the main moves are present: high digits as a row field padded to a multiple of W^k, base-m pieces at total cost O(V) sum a_j m^{j tau}=O(Ve^tau), and padding binary ranges to [q^e]. But the plan never interchanges the high rho digits pairwise or joins them into a row field of range q^{2 rho} (1660-1690), so as written the high parts are never exchanged. The unequal-width variant appears only implicitly in S6.2.3.

The steps cover the edge product of directional kernels, conjugation by P_M moving the residual basis to coordinate slots, (C^{-1})^{(x)f}=(-i)^f Z C^{(x)f} Z, exactly s_c children on f=e/m axes with C^{(x)e} on every role, and H_0^{(x)D}=b^D S_D C^{(x)D} S_D. Changes of basis are done by row additions (S4.6.5), as at 1892-1901.

Present: the eight-addition parity flip, the guard interval 10<=g<=2^{K-1}-11, delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^{-K}} by the union bound, sort-based repair and the slot application. The lemma's bound O(V(L^tau+1)+MA^3+delta_bad MA(R+A)) is missing; only the applied cost O(V((eK)^tau+1)) appears. The derivation omits the chunk swaps that place the target after its controls (source of the L^tau term, 2117-2155), the argument that T_0 S_0^{-1} permutes B (2107-2114), and the separate last selected position.

The steps follow the paper: node overhead O((eK)^tau+1), q_0 preprocessed chunks as a row index of range >=W^{k_0}, rows split u=Wg+w for 1/W volumes, F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) with leaves O(e) below d^beta, internal sum O(e^lambda), leaves O(e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)}), and base-m pieces giving O(d^{lambda'}).

It states Q_p(Hz) in O(Vd^{lambda'}) with error below sqrt2 2^{-p}, evaluated exactly with one final truncation. Guard width comes from A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E with E=64(W+m+1)^3, A<=8B^2 d^{nu+1} and C_0 d^{C_1}=o(p), and the disk bound from absolute row sum one, as at 2479-2586 and 2741-2757.

The steps cover character cancellation via the shift by t/2^{v+1}, decimation in frequency giving B_t F_t^- in bit-reversed order, the reverse procedure giving F_t^+ B_t^{-1}, grouped rounds H J_E, and the layout L (prefix-slot moves, at most Dq-1 width-K exchanges). They end with LBF^-, F^+B^{-1}L^{-1}, error below sqrt2 l 2^{-p} and cost O(Tp[dK+pK^{tau-1}+l d^{lambda'}]), all matching.

Evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, four products with the established multiplier, the separation |h_j|<=r2^{2p}<2^{3p}<B_0/2 for centered extraction, negacyclic reduction with |H_j|<=r2^{2p}, and cost O(rp log(rp)) all match the proof.

It keeps the common LB order (the pointwise product commutes with a common record permutation) and uses the normalization F^-(f*g)=M(F^-f)(F^-g). The error 3 delta+eta scaled to sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^{-p} and the cost with the log(rp) term match 3414-3495.

These steps follow the paper: T P_s F_s=P_t F_t S, the Neumann inverse of N=CTD, the normalizations giving 2^{-2 alpha^2}, errors 16p, 3p^2/4 and 4 at cost O(tp^{3/2+delta}alpha), and permutations left unexecuted. The tensor identity with gamma=2d alpha^2, error dp^2, the line count T/t_i and axis exposure O(Tp d^2(1+l^tau)) also match.

Both identities and the paper's proofs are given. Chirp periodicity uses even t_i, and the coefficient check (1/T)exp(2 pi i sum s_i j_i k_i/t_i) gives the chirp identity. F^+R_c=R_c^{-1}F^+ gives RF^+R=F^+, and with the convolution rule this gives (u*v)/S^2. Conjugation for RF^+ appears in S8.1.3.

The fixed rationals match eq:fixed-parameters, and b, p=6b, d, K, T, r, t_i, alpha, gamma, eta and the size relations match too. The primes come from the Rosser-Schoenfeld interval count with S/T>(1-1/(2d))^d>1/2, alpha^4 theta_i>3db>=p, an n^{o(1)} search, and no wraparound with coefficients below 2^{3b}.

These match 4204-4292: the isomorphism by order counting, the triangular formula b_i=a_i+mu_i sum_{j<i} a_j P_j mod s_i, updates in the order i=d..1 by prefix-controlled cyclic shifts of [0,s_i) that fix the padding, and cost O(Tp d^2(1+l^tau)).

Well-definedness (zeta y)^r=1, the diagonal isometric isomorphism, the wrap check zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h=zeta^j, M_C=D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g)=(f*g)/T and the computed twist sequence all match. The twist error bound 4*2^{-p} (4567-4579) is not stated.

The steps cover the source-transform composition and its exact counterpart RF_s, conjugation for the opposite sign, digits scaled to a_j 2^{-b-2}, the six steps, and the two occurrences of S undoing (u*v)/S^2. The S8.2 headline says 'rescales by S and 2^{2b+4}', loosely, but S8.2.4 gives the correct second scale 2^{2b+4}S.

The error chain from the chirp bound 8TL through E_s=9*2^gamma TL, the product error 2E_s+2, and E_w=S(3E_s+2)<28*2^gamma T^2 L to the final 448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2 matches, as do rounding and carries. The ring bound E_ring<5TL and the complex-convolution bound 6TL that feed the chirp bound are skipped (4582-4618).

The steps reproduce the cost table, the margins g_1..g_7 with min g_2=2^{-181}=2 kappa, the o(V) setup and exceptional-sorting bounds, polylog absorption by p^kappa, and the schoolbook cutoff, all as at 4815-4995.

The conjecture is named only in S0's relies-on tag (nlogn-conjecture), and S0's motivation alludes to the n log n barrier. No step states the eventual lower bound or that liminf T_A(n)/(n lg n)=0 refutes it.

errors.says: For both the form x^T(I-J/9)y (bit network) and the F_2 dot product (complex network), triple lines are nondegenerate and neighbouring lines orthogonal 'since <t_S,t_T>=|S cap T|-1'.
errors.paper: The formula <t_S,t_T>=|S cap T|-1 (with <t_T,t_T>=2) holds only for the rational form. For the binary labels t_T.t_T=1 and orthogonality comes from even intersection of neighbours.

errors.says: Peel off the top rho digits of each chunk as a row index, interchange the base-m pieces of the remaining width by the power-width procedure, then undo the padding.
errors.paper: The high parts h+, d+ are first interchanged pair by pair and joined into a row field of range q^{2 rho}>=W^k; after the remaining parts are interchanged, only the joining moves are reversed. Without that exchange the high digits would not be interchanged.

errors.says: The algorithm ... rescales by S and 2^{2b+4}.
errors.paper: The first scale is S and the second is 2^{2b+4}S, so S occurs twice to undo (u*v)/S^2. S8.2.4 and S8.2.5 state this correctly.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route from the subset-intersection exchange network, frames and nested labels, through the two interfaces with s<Wm and the exponent tau=1-2^{-50}, to the interchange and butterfly recursions, the synthetic transforms, resampling, the CRT and twist layout, exact recovery and the cost table. It reaches O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}). It thins in the label construction (no gate-label or edge-residual table), in arbitrary-width interchange (the high-digit exchange is missing) and in the packed selected-bit lemma (chunk swaps and its full time bound are missing). It never states the conjecture-negation step.

steps.note: Banks indexed by triples of 3-subsets, the fixed copy/gather/scatter/side-injection schedule, (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with every scratch wire restored, and m=10^6 are all present. h=100 and N=binom(h,3)^3 are never written out, so the network's size is given only through m.
Present: a common invertible frame per vertex, commutation with the pointwise gate G(D_v g_1..)=D_v G(g_1..), implemented operator D_out S D_in^{-1}, and edges costing only the change of frame.

Nested nondegenerate labels in an m-dimensional tensor space (stage transitions A(x)<t>(x)Q etc.), triple lines nondegenerate and neighbours orthogonal, comparable labels on every edge, and only central edges 3->4 decreasing, each by h. The gate-label table itself is not given.
P_V-P_U is the identity on V cap U^perp with rank dim V-dim U, and the N source edges are exceptions with 2P_{U_a} of rank one.
Source dimensions N, sink dimensions Wm-N, signed sum Wm-2N, L=Ich and absolute sum Wm-2N+2L, then s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539 are below 1/2, so the deficits N-2L_b>0 and 2N-2L_c>0 give s<Wm in both networks.
Endpoint difference P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m for X_a, 0 to I for every other role, and f'_{rho(w)}=Phi_{I_m} f_w, i.e. H<-H+D on every row including scratch rows.

A=E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones, the shear done with exactly a interchanges plus O(V) linear updates, each edge by recursive interchanges, and s recursive calls in all. The factorization is quoted, not proved.

Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), and eta>20*2^{-50} with m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20*2^{-50}) giving s/W<m^tau, tau=1-2^{-50}, then F_k=O(e^tau). log m<20 is used only implicitly, and the eta values are not given.

central.summary: All nine links of the central saving are reconstructed with their defining content, in the right roles. The chain runs: exchange network, frames, nested labels with the only loss on central 3->4 edges, rank equal to dimension change plus N source ranks, the budget Wm-2N+2L, L/N=100/539<1/2 giving s<Wm, the endpoint identity giving H<-H+D, edges as rank-many recursive interchanges, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. The gaps are minor: h=100 and N are never stated explicitly, the gate-label table is absent, and log m<20 and the exact eta values are left implicit.
